note: Signed in, top-level folders fit one page: one list_folder. Each extra page adds one continue. Before the performance fixes: the same, but on every visit.

A later revisit, or the first after a relaunch with the Caches listing, is one list_folder/continue with an empty reply. Before: a full listing (1 request per page).
The session reads the token store once, off the main actor, then caches the tokens. Before: one read on the main actor while the Drawings tab was built, plus one per request.
Pages after the session's one read cost no Keychain read. Before: 1 per page.
Tokens are written only when they change (sign-in, renewal), never by a listing with fresh tokens.
Two callers needing a renewal at once (lapsed token, or two 401s) share one renewal. Before: up to 2.
Two callers listing the same folder at once share one request chain. Before: 2 chains.
